declare

 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);

 temp_no_of_comp number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 then

 begin

 from component_spiking
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 process_code = :process_code and
 sysdate between trunc(insert_dats) and
 trunc(insert_dats)+365 ;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then

 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 show_error('0124');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select product_desc
 into :s_product_code_desc
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5)
 and unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from valid_products');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select component_prefix
 into :component_prefix
 from component_spiking
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 process_code = :process_code and
 sysdate between insert_dats and
 trunc(insert_dats)+365;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0124');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 if :global.code_scheme = 'I' 
 then
 :component_prefix := substr(:product_code,7,2);
 else
 :component_prefix := null;
 end if;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from component_sp-1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Item.Name: BAG_LOT_NUMBER
Item.Hint: Enter the bag lot number or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_sysdate date;
 x_lot varchar2(30);
begin
 v_sysdate:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 /*
 select lot_number into x_lot from valid_lots where lot_number=:bag_lot_number and 
 sp_flag in (select code from master_codes where code_type='CMC' and INSTR(code_desc,:banner.prog_name,1) >0) and 
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_sysdate+365) ;
 */
 -- MLT 1974
 select lot_number into x_lot
 from valid_lots VL where 
 EXISTS (select 'X' from master_codes where code_type='CMC' and
 INSTR(VL.sp_flag,code,1)>0 and
 INSTR(code_desc,:banner.prog_name,1) >0 and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl (term_date,v_sysdate+365)
 ) 
 and lot_number = :bag_lot_number and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_sysdate+365)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and rownum=1;
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1200');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;
